coaching.headline: Steady strides, keep that heart in check! 🏃‍♀️
coaching.coaching: Today's 7 km at 8:24 /​km kept your average HR at 154 bpm, right under the MAF ceiling of 155 bpm, so the aerobic base effort was solid. However, the pace is a bit slower than your 7:50‑8:10 /​km target and the peak HR of 165 bpm shows occasional spikes that you should smooth out. Keep focusing on staying in Zone 2 the whole run and watch the short bursts that push the HR up.
coaching.trend: Your recent runs show a stable HR range (145‑156 bpm) and gradual pace improvement, but the average speed is still a few seconds per km above the goal. Consistency is good, but the aerobic training effect is only moderate (3/5).
coaching.nextRun: Run 8 km at a target pace of 7:55‑8:05 /​km, keep HR no higher than 155 bpm, and work on cadence above 170 spm while aiming for ground‑contact time under 280 ms.
